subject: Compile error: metis.h: No such file or directory

messages.author: fb1667ba74f25458
messages.subject: Compile error: metis.h: No such file or directory
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to setup a devel environment for INLA - I am actually interest only in the R part, but it seemed that setting up the whole thing would be easier than to figure out how to force the R project to take my existing INLA binaries. If there is an easy trick to just compile the R package, it would solve my problems.

What I did so far:
I downloaded http://www.r-inla-download.org/hrue/hfiles/build64.tgz and ran
make download
make zlib
make gsl
make metis
make taucs
make amd
make muparser
make GMRFLib

at which point I get
smtp-taucs.c:50:10: fatal error: metis.h: No such file or directory

I am running a virtual Ubuntu 18.04 box from a Windows environment (somehow the idea of compiling under Windows did not feel at all enticing :-)

Thanks for any hints
Martin

for tweaking with posterior sample, do you not need to compile the
binary. if I change some R code, I can check that after doing

just add your stuff that one; you'll see
